clue.text: Tear madly after a taxi to see a show

indicators.note: after places the scrambled letters behind the word for taxi

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

indicators.note: madly suggests the letters of the word tear are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written as the letters to be scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone rushes off in a cab, desperate to catch a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tear' reads as rushing off, but 'madly' rearranges it (ARET), and 'after' sets it behind the cab.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is a form of entertainment staged in a nightclub or restaurant.

clue.text: Being less encumbered, the French are in credit

indicators.note: in places the French article plus the word are inside the credit abbreviation

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
le is the French masculine word for the
taken as written

explanation.surface: A French debtor feels freer once their account is back in the black.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearer means freer of obstruction, so less weighed down.

clue.text: Negotiated with counsel and won

parts.note: the Bar is the body of barristers, the counsel in a court
gained means won or obtained

explanation.surface: A deal was struck with the help of a lawyer and came out ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To bargain is to haggle over terms, so negotiated is its past tense.

clue.text: An equestrian, it's clear, about to mount

parts.note: to rid is to clear of something

indicators.note: in a down clue mounting means going up, so the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A horseman is clearly about to climb into the saddle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mount' suggests getting on a horse; in a down clue 'to mount' means reading upwards (ER).
explanation.definitionFit: A rider is a horseman, someone who sits on a horse.

clue.text: Practical catch-line — makes a change!

indicators.note: the phrase invites the letters of the catch-line to be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A sensible slogan offers a welcome bit of variety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'makes a change' rearranges the nine letters of CATCHLINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Technical knowledge is applied, hands-on skill, in the sense of practical know-how.

clue.text: The duck in the river sound black

parts.note: the Po is the longest river in Italy

indicators.note: sound tells us the word for black is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: charred means blackened by burning

explanation.surface: A duck floats on a river whose waters are dark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like the river's noise, yet it signals a homophone of the word for blackened; the Po is Italy's great river.
explanation.definitionFit: The pochard is a European diving duck with a chestnut head.

clue.text: Spread over a quarter

parts.note: past means over or finished
E for east is one of the four compass points, a quarter

explanation.surface: Something is smeared across a quarter of a surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A paste is a soft mixture such as fish paste that is spread on bread.

clue.text: It takes a woman cleaner to see the cigarette ends

parts.note: a char is a British cleaning lady
lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: the ends of the word cigarette are its closing letters, here the final three

explanation.surface: Only a woman who cleans would spot cigarette butts lying around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' takes TTE, the last three letters of cigarette. A char is British slang for a cleaning woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte is a female first name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: A snake seen in summer

definitions.meaning: read as one who sums, a person doing addition

explanation.definitionFit: An adder is both Britain's only venomous serpent and, literally, somebody who adds up figures.

clue.text: Harry', an old soldier

definitions.meaning: to harry is to harass or coerce
a mounted infantryman of former times

explanation.definitionFit: To dragoon is to bully someone into acting, and a dragoon was a cavalryman of earlier armies.

clue.text: Another redoubtable leader has made a gaffe

indicators.note: has signals that the preceding words contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: A second formidable chief has committed a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across 'anothER REDoubtable'; 'leader' is only scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to make a mistake, and a gaffe is a social blunder.

clue.text: She foresaw trouble about dope with an artist

parts.note: C for circa means about
an ass is a fool, a dope
and means together with
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A woman predicted problems concerning drugs and a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an' is a link word here; RA stands for a member of the Royal Academy.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend the Trojan princess Cassandra prophesied doom but was never believed.

clue.text: Back 13 to score again

parts.note: rear means back
the answer to 13 across, a row

explanation.surface: Returning to a theme, a composer rewrites the music.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference points to 13 across, meaning a row; 'score' is musical, not points in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: To score music is to arrange it, so doing it again is a fresh arrangement.

clue.text: Musicians will not rush to perform so

definitions.text: Musicians will not rush to perform so

parts.words: Musicians will not rush to perform so
parts.note: an instruction on a score telling players to go slowly and broadly

explanation.definitionFit: Largo is the Italian tempo marking for a slow, stately pace.

clue.text: A display of unbridled anger — a row

indicators.note: unbridled means let loose, so the letters of anger run free in a new order

explanation.surface: An outburst of uncontrolled temper ends in a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' tempts as a quarrel; here it means a line, as of hills.
explanation.definitionFit: A range of mountains is a line or chain of them.

clue.text: Makes proper use of training

definitions.meaning: as in employing a right or power

explanation.definitionFit: One exercises a right by using it, and exercises are drills done for fitness.

clue.text: Limit studies with tutor

parts.note: to con is to study, so cons means studies
to train is to tutor or teach

explanation.surface: A student cuts back on reading with a tutor.
explanation.definitionFit: To constrain is to restrict or hold in check.

clue.text: The last place to deal for a game of cards

parts.note: new means latest
a market is where trading is done

explanation.surface: Card players hunt for one final spot to deal a hand.
explanation.walkthrough: Newmarket is also an English horse-racing town, a further hint of a place.
explanation.definitionFit: Newmarket is a card game in which players stake on matching cards.

clue.text: He'll set about a craft worker about to go sick

parts.note: SS is a steamship, a craft
to ail is to be sick
the worker ant is the crossword's stock worker

explanation.surface: An artisan is close to falling ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set about' means attack, so the definition is an attacker; 'about to' is padding and the worker comes last in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An assailant is an attacker, one who sets upon a victim.

clue.text: It's strange being a member of an order

definitions.meaning: a weird person, an eccentric chap
one who belongs to a fraternal friendly society

explanation.definitionFit: An eccentric person is an odd fellow, and the Oddfellows are a friendly society whose members bear this title.

clue.text: A person of authority put in charge in advance

definitions.text: A person of authority put in charge in advance

parts.words: A person of authority put in charge in advance
parts.note: someone appointed beforehand to a post of command

explanation.definitionFit: An officer holds a commission giving command over others.

clue.text: A canvas stand

parts.note: reads like a stall made of cloth, but it is the painter's support

explanation.definitionFit: An artist's frame holds a painting upright while it is worked on.

clue.text: The girl could be brighter!

parts.note: sounds like a slight on her wits, but brighter means shedding more light

explanation.definitionFit: Lighter means brighter, paler, and a lighter also makes a flame.

clue.text: Managed to divide notes, making money

indicators.note: to divide means to come between, so ran splits the two notes

parts.note: F and C are musical notes
ran means managed

explanation.surface: Someone organised the sharing of banknotes to make cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' looks like banknotes; it gives the musical notes F and C.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc was the currency of France and remains that of Switzerland.

clue.text: Quite unconcerned at finding a mug upset

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word reads upwards

parts.note: a mug is a fool, a gullible person

explanation.surface: Someone is unbothered to find their mug knocked over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' in a down clue turns the dupe upside down (LOOF). 'mug' looks like a cup but is a gullible person.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloof means distant and detached, not caring.

clue.text: Beginning to accept the left can be most unexpected

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the word for beginning holds the letter

parts.note: starting means beginning
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Starting to welcome the political Left can be a real surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be most' is link padding; the definition is 'unexpected'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something startling is surprising and sudden.

clue.text: An accident caused by 20

definitions.meaning: a tumble or a fall, as from a horse
the answer at 20 down, a device for kindling flame

explanation.definitionFit: A spill is both a fall and a thin taper of wood or paper used to carry a flame.

clue.text: The top decoration for a woman

definitions.text: The top decoration for a woman

parts.words: The top decoration for a woman
parts.note: sounds like the highest award, but it is ornament worn on her head

explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled crown or headband.

clue.text: An implement for eating meat paste

parts.note: a chop is a cut of meat
to stick is to paste or glue

explanation.surface: A tool for eating meat paste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meat paste' reads as one food, but splits into two separate words.
explanation.definitionFit: Chopsticks are the paired sticks used for eating in East Asia.

clue.text: A piece that's not taken into account

definitions.meaning: read as two words, one portion

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is one portion, and apart means aside or excluded.

clue.text: Rejection is not imagined — endless trouble is involved

indicators.note: is involved means is taken into, so the trimmed word goes inside

parts.note: real means not imagined

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the word for trouble is dropped

parts.note: a fuss is trouble or bother

explanation.surface: Being turned down is no fantasy, and it causes no end of bother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops the last letter of the word for trouble (FUS); 'is involved' puts that inside the word for not imagined.
explanation.definitionFit: A refusal is a rejection of an offer or request.

clue.text: A kitchen gadget for blending rotates

indicators.note: blending means mixing, so the letters of rotates are mixed up

explanation.surface: A food mixer turns its blades for blending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blending' suggests a blender, but it rearranges ROTATES.
explanation.definitionFit: A toaster browns bread slices with heat.
